out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: 1) salmon 2) tuna
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. SEND EHS A COPY OF THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM THE TWO FISH VENDORS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) unsalted butter at ambient temperature was observed at 77f. Upon discussion with PIC, unsalted butter was placed out 2 hours prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD THE UNSALTED BUTTER IN 2 HOURS. UNSALTED BUTTER MUST BE MAINTAINED COLD AT 41f OR LESS OR BE KEPT ON TPHC. Davio's Northern Italian Steakhouse (Inspection Date: 08/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: 1) Béarnaise sauces
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO LABEL THE SAUCES WITH THE TIME IT WAS PUT OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED (4 HOURS LATER). PIC LABELED THE SAUCES. ALWAYS LABEL THE SAUCES WITH THE TPHC START TIME AND END TIME.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw fish was being stored above Ready-to-eat soup in the 3DR sauté prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW FISH TO BOTTOM SHELF OF THE COOLER NEXT TO THE SOUP.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The high temperature dish machine at the bar was observed being used to clean glasses. Using EHS’s high temperature dish plate, bar dish machine was observed at 156f.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCONTINUE USING THIS DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED. ALL DISHES WILL BE TAKEN TO THE KITCHEN TO BE WASHED AND SANITIZED. CHEF STATES HE WILL CALL FOR SERVICE TODAY

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR stacked Hot Box, mashed potatoes were observed at 129f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CHEF DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed intact reduce oxygen packaged frozen Raw tuna being thawed in coolers. No hole or slit was observed in the packaging
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CUT OPEN THE PACKAGING AT THE START OF THE THAWING PROCESS. OPEN PACKAGING OF FROZEN RAW FISH MAY BE THAWED IN COOLERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) bar high temperature dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPAIR DISH MACHINE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No certified food manager was present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BECOME CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS TO ENSURE THERE IS A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION. MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food in Vending Machine, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food dispensed through a vending machine being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: sautéed spinach and container of tomato sauce were observed being stored for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it exceeds 7 days or at 41F. STAFF MEMBER DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: EHS observed no hand washing sign at the hand sink in the server/coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO POST A HAND WASHING SIGN. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Blue cheese (50f), blue cheese dressing (47f), arugula (45f) in the 3DR prep top across from grill (main kitchen, middle right).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO COVER THE TCS FOOD IN BETWEEN USE TO PROTECT IT FROM THE GRILL HEAT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: EHS observed the following food being held for more than 7 days: 1) tomato soup and clam chowder in the 3DR prep top across from the stove in the main kitchen; 2) Parmesan panko in the 3DR prep top (left one) in the secondary kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS. Davio's Northern Italian Steakhouse (Inspection Date: 03/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: EHS observed pink discoloration in the upper portion of the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC STATES THAT IT WILL BE CLEAN TODAY. PLEASE DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE ICE MACHINE UNTIL IT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: EHS observed two knives being stored in between two 3DR prep top coolers in the main kitchen. EHS observed utensils being stored in a container full of water on the stove in the main kitchen. EHS observed deli containers and other plastic containers with no handles being stored in the flour bulk bins and semolina bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO NOT STORE KNIVES IMPROPERLY. PIC BROUGHT THE CONTAINER FULL OF WATER AND UTENSILS TO THE DISH WASHER. PIC REMOVED DELI CONTAINERS AND OTHER PLASTIC CONTAINERS FROM THE BULK BINS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: EHS observed mop being stored improperly. Mop head was being stored in the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. ALLOW MOP TO AIR DRY BY INVERTING AND HANGING THE MOP. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. EHS observed staff personal belongings throughout the main kitchen, secondary kitchen and server/coffee area. EHS observed staff’s personal food being stored alongside food designated for the customers in the main kitchen coolers and in the server/coffee station cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO DESIGNATE AN AREA OR AREAS FOR STAFF’S PERSONAL BELONGINGS AND STAFF’S PERSONAL FOOD. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
